scope: Canonical contracts and separately attributed public roles, scoped fixed-block identity observations, and a separate bounded indexed-creation discovery inventory; not an audit or independently verified live deployment universe.

4663.name: Robinhood Etherscan
4663.scope: Robinhood Etherscan is the default object-navigation provider for chain 4663, including historical objects, not an exclusive research or citation provider. Suitable alternatives and original source URLs may be researched and cited. Derived navigation links are not verification or proof of API access; preserve original evidence URLs, dates and attribution.

record_notes.publisher_verification_claim: An attributed publisher label, not independent live-chain verification by this package. Preserve live_chain_verification_status and lifecycle limits.
record_notes.fixed_block_market_identity: A market's observation records only the named getter results, chain, block/hash/time and identity-hash check. It does not promote singleton/dependency contract records to live-chain-verified status or establish balances, oracle safety, liquidity, permissions or continued availability. Market IDs remain separate from chain/address counts.
record_notes.indexed_receipt_evidence: A successful explorer-indexed creation or trade corroborates only that indexed event and identity. It is not a direct fixed-block RPC audit, verified Solidity source, complete authority review, current activation check or proof of later settlement.
record_notes.publisher_linked_provenance_urls: Original publisher hyperlinks retained as source evidence and direct citations. Robinhood Etherscan templates supply default object links after exact identity validation, not an exclusive provider requirement. Do not transplant provider-specific API paths or query tabs to another host.
record_notes.price_feed_metadata: Publisher-directory provenance is in the parent contract provenance array and covers only the proxy and metadata fields named by its locator, including adjacent feed decimals. It does not establish a token pairing, current round, deployed behavior or NetNet use. Consumer policies and semantics sources remain separately attributed.
record_notes.netnet_use_evidence: Directory inclusion alone does not establish NetNet use. Preserve recorded registry/local provenance and status; an empty consumer_policies list means not recorded, not unused. No exhaustive consumer list or exact-token relationship is inferred.
record_notes.public_role_addresses: Published or explicitly explorer-discovered operational roles, not proof of control, beneficial ownership or personal identity. An explorer-reported EOA is attributed metadata, not a current code audit.
record_notes.discovery_inventory: 53 baseline-missing indexed creations are separate candidates, not 53 active products. Four now point to canonical roles; ten historically named and39 unclassified candidates remain outside canonical counts. Shared deployer/time does not prove role, successor identity or activity.
record_notes.v4_pool_and_position_identity: V4 pool IDs are bytes32 hashes of complete PoolKeys, not addresses, transaction hashes or NFT IDs. PoolManager and PositionManager are distinct canonical contracts. Fixed-block ownership/cardinality observations do not establish current ownership, source equivalence or balance-sheet value.
record_notes.advance_identity: AdvanceDesk and AdvanceZap have separate canonical roles. September26 explorer indexed creations corroborate September25 date/block; matching transaction raw input/creation bytecode and independent RLP CREATE derivation resolve the publisher's swapped diary labels at explorer-evidence level. Targeted deployed-bytecode analysis supports explicitly scoped conditional mechanics, not independently pinned RPC code/state, verified Solidity, real dependency execution or a full audit. Publisher ABI names remain labels; runtime branch evidence is separately attributed in advance-interface.json and advance-routes.json. Position IDs/counts must be discovered fresh, never seeded from dated examples.

known_discrepancies.detail: Official Channels still lists 0x99B6eE6eDe47d9a8a9bfd03F728a99B789df1961 as RwaDesk. The public app registry and local definitions identify it as V1 superseded by V2 0xa84efC3136BF1Bb89ade9E5BE6Ab32cb1A04f08D on 2026-08-27. Both addresses are retained; current status is publisher/local-reported, not live verified.

Official Channels says deployed 2026-08-19; app registry dates the listed v1.1 desk to 2026-08-18 at block 40019315 and explicitly supersedes v1.0. No date reconciliation or receipt verification was performed. Long-Dated TurboDesk is distinct from Loopback TurboRouter.

Credit docs say vault mainnet since 2026-09-09 and first loan 2026-09-10 but explicitly keep CreditRouter pending the allocator grant. The app registry identifies the same router address as V2 and identifies a never-granted V1 predecessor. Do not equate vault operation or a public registry address with router activation.

NetNetGear shared loot collection 0x621342F15f86fd5620c5141D0cc1A6ceFDaE28eE and boardroomLoot library 0x6C2B1e062DA09d18389cC563D75B1e1899F2a02f are separate named contracts, not address aliases. Retired initial NetNetGear deployment is also retained.

known_discrepancies.topic: LP Zap deployment versus public app availability
known_discrepancies.detail: The September 16 indexed creation corroborates the LP Zap address. On September 18 the app registry still labels it PLACEHOLDER and its Add liquidity panel gates the one-transaction route pending levy exemption, offering direct Uniswap provision instead. PLACEHOLDER does not mean undeployed; registry promotion and current on-chain exemption are not independently established.

known_discrepancies.topic: Predict launch versus historical NAV Pool proposal
known_discrepancies.detail: Predict's observed binary market displays combined Treasury and Sleeve and has a depositor-funded House Vault. Do not import backing-per-NET brackets, parimutuel rules or no-house-side assumptions from the older NAV Pool proposal. Series outcome identities do not establish resolver authority, exact tie/void rules or audited vault solvency.

known_discrepancies.topic: THE BOOK house versus Predict House Vault
known_discrepancies.detail: Original September 20 targeted THE BOOK review: SportsBookDesk holds wsNET and published rules identify the house as the RWA Sleeve, never Treasury. Its house pot is not the depositor-funded USDG Predict House Vault. Launch language, publisher HUMAN-VERIFIED labels and successful indexed creation metadata do not verify source equivalence, current authority, balances or solvency. That review lacked fixed-block direct reads; later user-reported public RPC observations remain separately attributed, not a blanket audit or a permanent live-access restriction.

coverage.scope: Address-specific counts only. Source inventory, extraction boundaries, gaps and content-review status are maintained in the linked source catalog, not duplicated here.
coverage.contract_count_composition: 158 named contract records + 37 underlying price-feed contract records = 195 unique chain/address pairs. Feed records are included in the total, not an additional 37 addresses.
